data.summary: Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 14+ years of progressive experience across Investment Banking and Capital Markets, including senior roles at CitiCorp, Credit Suisse, UBS, and BNY Mellon. Deep domain expertise in trade lifecycle management, securities data warehousing, and front-to-back office operations spanning Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and OTC Derivatives. Proven track record in leading cross-functional stakeholder engagement, Agile delivery, BRD/FRD documentation, and leveraging Gen AI tools for process automation and requirement synthesis.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 14+ years of progressive experience across Investment Banking and Capital Markets, including senior roles at CitiCorp, Credit Suisse, UBS, and BNY Mellon. Deep domain expertise in trade lifecycle management, securities data warehousing, and front-to-back office operations spanning Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and OTC Derivatives. Proven track record in leading cross-functional stakeholder engagement, Agile delivery, BRD/FRD documentation, and leveraging Gen AI tools for process automation and requirement synthesis.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Trade Lifecycle & Securities Operations
BRD/FRD & User Story Documentation
Equities, Fixed Income, FX, OTC Derivatives
Agile/Scrum & Sprint Management
Data Warehouse & Feed Management (GPDW)
UAT Coordination & Functional Testing
SQL Data Analysis & API Testing • Stakeholder Management & Wealth Management • RAAS (Recon as a Service) tool
Gen AI Utilisation & Process Automation
JIRA, Confluence, Postman, Swagger, SoapUI
Generative AI
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
★ Managed top 5% platinum clients at BNY Mellon; consistently exceeded SLA and quality benchmarks.
★ Reduced BRD/FRD drafting time by ~40% at CitiCorp through Gen AI (Stylus & Assist) adoption and used Gen AI to better understand SQL stored procedures
★ Recipient of consecutive Rising Star Awards at BNY Mellon
★ Identified 30+ pre-UAT critical defects at Credit Suisse — reduced post-release regression cycle by 25%
★ Saved ~75 hours per year via Enterprize Document Management (print reduction)
★ Achieved 100% on-time delivery across 6 major quarterly releases at Honeywell engagement
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
AVP - Business Analyst | CitiCorp | Global Products Data Warehouse
May 2023 - May 2026
◗ Lead end-to-end requirement analysis, As-Is / To-Be gap analysis, and BRD/FRD documentation for GPDW — a mission-critical platform providing several downstream feeds and reporting, replacing legacy stock record applications across Cash Securities.
◗ Drive stakeholder coordination across upstream/downstream teams for data-feed integrations
spanning 6 cross-functional groups in 3 time zones; conduct sprint ceremonies, track delivery risks, and ensure on-time release.
◗ Leverage internal Gen AI tools (Stylus & Assist) to accelerate user story creation and
requirement synthesis, improving documentation throughout by ~40% and enhancing consistency across sprint cycles.
◗ Design and maintain detailed data-mapping artefacts capturing field-level transformations between source and target systems; support sign-off by data governance and enterprise architecture teams.
◗ Own JIRA backlog management, risk/dependency dashboards, and full requirement-to-UAT
traceability; delivered zero-defect go-live on two major platform releases.
◗ Facilitate cross-regional requirements workshops and executive stakeholder reviews, ensuring
alignment between business expectations and technical delivery across geographically distributed teams.
◗ Produce sprint velocity metrics, release-readiness reports, and programme status summaries for
senior leadership, enabling data-driven decision-making at programme level.
Senior Business Analyst | Credit Suisse (via HCL Technologies) | Applicable Offering Platform
Apr 2021 - Apr 2023
◗ Delivered full BA support for an investment platform, which is a Wealth Management application,
enabling real-time product applicability checks for trading and investment recommendation applications across 4 global business lines, including RMPLUS and KYC updation app.
◗ Authored detailed BRDs, FRDs, data-mapping documents, and end-to-end test scripts; managed stakeholder communications and requirement traceability in Confluence across geographically dispersed teams.
◗ Executed functional and API testing using Swagger and SoapUI; identified 30+ critical pre-UAT
defects, preventing production incidents and reducing regression cycle time by ~25%. ◗ Performed gap analysis between existing system behaviour and target-state requirements,
producing prioritised defect lists and remediation recommendations for the development team. ◗ Maintained change-request log and impact-assessment register; ensured full traceability from
business requirements through test results to UAT sign-off across all four business lines. ◗ Coordinated UAT cycles by scripting test scenarios, tracking defect resolution in JIRA, and
facilitating sign-off sessions with business stakeholders and technology leads.
Business Analyst | UBS & Honeywell (via Dell International Services) Client: Honeywell Technologies – Finance & QA Applications (May 2017 – Apr 2021)
May 2016 - Apr 2021
◗ Directed end-to-end BA and functional testing for Honeywell finance applications in Agile; led a
cross-functional team of 8 across QA and BA tracks covering payment tools and OS applications.
◗ Managed UAT coordination for production releases across 6 major quarterly cycles, achieving
100% on-time delivery in the final two years of the engagement.
◗ Defined acceptance criteria and coordinated UAT with business owners, resulting in zero
post-release critical defects in the final 4 quarters.
◗ Championed process improvements that reduced regression testing effort by approximately 20%
over the engagement lifecycle through root-cause analysis and test-automation recommendations.
Client: UBS – Trade Risk Analysis (May 2016 – Apr 2017)
◗ Led BA activities for UBS trade analysis project across Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and OTC Derivatives; assigned risk factors based on evidence review, T+2 settlement validation, and communicated findings to stakeholders.
◗ Led BA transition including knowledge-transfer documentation, process maps, and stakeholder
onboarding; executed UAT for 3 production releases with zero post-release P1 incidents.
◗ Collaborated with risk and compliance teams to document business rules governing trade-risk
classification, ensuring accuracy and consistency across multi-asset class portfolios.
◗ Maintained traceability matrices linking business requirements to test cases, enabling efficient
impact assessment and change management across the engagement.
Analyst | Bank of New York Mellon | Trade Settlement Operations
Aug 2010 - Dec 2015
◗ Managed complete trade settlement lifecycle for Equities, Fixed Income, and FX products;
performed trade validation, SWIFT message processing, and break resolution with brokers and custodians under T+2 mandates.
◗ Serviced top 5% platinum clients at BNY Mellon; consistently exceeded SLA targets and received the Rising Star Award for two consecutive months for exceptional client service.
◗ Implemented Kaizen process improvement initiative automating reconciliation workflows, saving
~75 working hours annually and improving throughput with no increase in headcount.
◗ Coordinated with internal operations, custody, and broker counterparties to resolve settlement
breaks within agreed timelines, maintaining near-zero aged-break positions on key client accounts.
◗ Prepared daily settlement reports, trade exception logs, and client-facing status communications,
ensuring timely escalation of unresolved items to senior management.
◗ Trained and mentored junior analysts on SWIFT messaging standards, settlement procedures, and client servicing protocols, supporting consistent team performance during high-volume periods.
MBA - Finance & Marketing - ICFAI University | 2009 NCFM – Capital Market Dealer Module
AMFI – Advisory Module & IRDA Certification
Business Analysis Workshop - COEPD Institute
